name: Plex-TVTime
description: Plex-TVTime is a Plex webhook handler that automatically updates your TVTime watch history. TV episodes are automatically marked as watched once you complete them on Plex.

variables.name: Plex Users
variables.description: Single Plex user or comma separated list of Plex users to send events for

variables.name: Excluded TV Shows
variables.description: Leave blank for no restrictions. A comma separated list of TV show titles that will not be sent to TVTime. TVShow title should be identicle to how it appears in your Plex library. If the title includes a comma in it replace it with %2C to avoid conflicting with the comma delimeters in the list

variables.name: Included TV Shows
variables.description: Leave blank for no restrictions. Overridden and ignored if PLEX_SHOWS_EXCLUDE is set, otherwise only shows that appear in this list will be sent to TVTime

variables.name: Logging Level
variables.description: Set to TRACE or DEBUG for additional logging
